sub_questions: What mechanisms produce hallucination in large language models?

key_findings: Retrieval grounds generation in retrieved passages rather than parametric memory.
reader.methodology: Survey of mitigation techniques across 2020-2024 systems.
reader.results_summary: Grounded decoding reduces unsupported claims on the surveyed benchmarks.
reader.limitations: Abstract-only analysis; no reproduction of the reported numbers.

synthesizer.draft_report:
# Hallucination in large language models

Retrieval-augmented generation grounds model output in retrieved documents rather than parametric memory [Ji, 2023].

## Evidence

The surveyed systems report fewer unsupported claims once decoding is conditioned on retrieved passages [Ji, 2023].
